method: Crypto v2 plus BTC 200d trend gate: at each Monday rebalance, if BTC closes below its 200-day SMA the sleeve holds 40% BTC and 60% cash with no alts; otherwise normal v2 (BTC 50% + top-2 alts 15% each). Simulated, never booked.
judge: Judge 2026-12-14 (4 Mondays). Promote if shadow leads live v2 by >1.5 pts with no more drawdown; kill if it trails by >1 pt.
